payload.title: Publish safe optimization workbook revisions
payload.description:
As a stakeholder, I want a simple spreadsheet representation of optimization evidence, so that I can review and work with the findings safely.

Feature: Optimization workbook revisions

Scenario: Publish a verified workbook
  Given complete or explicitly incomplete decision evidence
  When a report milestone is published
  Then a macro-free workbook contains the defined stakeholder sheets
  And its row counts reconcile with the evidence
  And the report points to the newest immutable revision

Scenario: Protect restricted evidence
  Given evidence contains opaque identifiers or sensitive source material
  When the stakeholder workbook is generated
  Then displayed cells contain only aggregates, findings, and dashboard links
  And raw evidence remains in restricted artifact attachments
  And spreadsheet formulas cannot be injected through source text
